entries.mitigation: Block the frontal wave or step to the side before it lands; keep Ulguna faced away from the group when possible.
Destroy all four Feast orbs before they reach Ulguna. Clearing them releases the trapped player and prevents the boss from healing.
Block the heavy slam to prevent the knockdown, and keep Grothdarr faced away from non-tanks.
Stay out of the moving lava trails. Following behind a trail rather than crossing its leading edge can preserve safer space.
Sidestep the targeted flame line and do not stand in the lingering fire it leaves behind.
Move or dodge out of the large impact area, then return close enough to keep Iskra from stretching the fight across the room.
Stay reasonably close to the group; Iskra targets the furthest player with the leap, so excessive range creates unnecessary movement and splash pressure.
Pull the summoned undead into the group and kill them quickly so add pressure does not overlap later arena mechanics.
Move out of the dark ground runes; they damage and snare players even though they lack the usual red telegraph.
Move out of the central spirit-filled area until the effect ends, then return to the boss.
Stay inside the protective dome. Players outside it when the room-breaking blast resolves take extreme damage.
